evals.name: rerun-preserves-unrelated-config
evals.prompt: Re-run setup to add a second fleet.root and one canonical override. The existing config has comments, a fleet.repo, and another canonical section.
evals.expected_output: Setup updates only the requested entries, preserves comments and unrelated fleet/canonical entries, validates with git config, and runs a read-only audit. It does not edit user settings or remotes.
expectations: Preserves comments and unrelated existing entries
Adds only the requested root and canonical override
Does not edit pluginConfigs, user settings, or Git remotes

evals.name: canonical-identity-must-be-verified
evals.prompt: Add a canonical override because two directories are both named dotfiles, but their GitHub remotes are different repositories.
evals.expected_output: Setup rejects the name-based inference and requires matching normalized GitHub remote identity before writing the override.
expectations: Does not infer canonical equivalence from directory names
Leaves the config unchanged on mismatch
